evals.prompt: Before I decide whether this release can be promoted, check the reliability workstream handoff policy for the production promotion constraints and tell me exactly where that rule lives.
evals.expected_output: The agent consults the navigational index, recomputes the source SHA-256 at runtime, recognizes the index as unindexed or refreshes it on a digest mismatch, reads only the governing range, and answers with the freshness status plus the verbatim heading and line range.
expectations: The agent opens references/reliability-workstream-handoff-index.md and resolves docs/operations/reliability_workstreams/handoff_prompts.md from the repository root.
The agent recomputes the SHA-256 digest at runtime and compares it with the recorded value, explicitly handling the unindexed or mismatch state.
Only the governing range is read, and the reply reports the freshness status with the governing heading and line range.

evals.prompt: You looked up the workstream handoff rules earlier in this conversation. Now tell me what the admission rule says for a new workstream owner.
evals.expected_output: The agent reuses the compact index rather than rereading the whole policy document, confirms freshness with a runtime digest check, and cites the governing admission heading and line range.
expectations: The earlier retrieval does not exempt the agent from the runtime freshness check.
The answer cites the governing heading and line range and uses only that range.

evals.prompt: Summarize the pagination section of our public API reference so I can update the developer portal.
evals.expected_output: The reliability workstream index is not consulted because the request is about unrelated API documentation.
expectations: The agent does not compute a digest of docs/operations/reliability_workstreams/handoff_prompts.md.
